This template shows a user interface card that you can move in 3D space.

<b>On Desktop:</b> Click and drag the card to move it.\
<b>In XR:</b> Select and drag the card to move it.\
<b>Key components:</b> `xb.UICard`, `xb.UIPanel`, `xb.UIText`, and
`xb.UIButton`, managed by `UIManager.js`.
